facts.text: AndorCamera wraps the upstream AndorCam object and takes its default acquisition attributes as the attribute dictionary
get_attribute returns the current value of one named acquisition attribute
set_attribute stores a named acquisition attribute in the dictionary
configure_acquisition hands the whole attribute dictionary to AndorCam.setup_acquisition
snap configures the acquisition, acquires, downloads the images and returns them
abort_acquisition calls the camera's abort and records that the abort happened
stop_acquisition is a no-op (pass); abort_acquisition is the upstream stop path
AndorCam.setup_acquisition accepts the acquisition modes single, accumulate, kinetic_series, fast_kinetics and run_till_abort
AndorCam.setup_acquisition sets the exposure time with SetExposureTime and reads the actual timings back with GetAcquisitionTimings
AndorCam.setup_trigger accepts the trigger modes internal, external, external_start and external_exposure, and the edges rising and falling
enable_cooldown refuses a temperature set point outside self.temperature_range, which initialize_camera fills from GetTemperatureRange()
enable_cooldown compares the requested set point with self.temperature_range before switching the cooler on
AndorCam.shutdown refuses to shut down while the camera is armed
The SDK binding loads atmcd64d.dll or atmcd32d.dll with ctypes and names the Andor SDK3 install directory only on Windows
The upstream default acquisition attributes configure a 2560 x 2160 frame, 1 x 1 binning and a 20 ms exposure; they are defaults, not device limits

operator_required.name: exposure_time
operator_required.reason: the clone passes the exposure to SetExposureTime and reads the actual timing back with GetAcquisitionTimings, but no text file states a numeric exposure range; the site sets it

operator_required.name: temperature_setpoint
operator_required.reason: enable_cooldown validates the set point against self.temperature_range, which is queried from the camera with GetTemperatureRange() at initialization; the clone states no fixed range, so the site sets it
